title: Startup Examples for STM32WL33 targets
body: There is no startup example for STM32WL33 targets

comments.author: RJMSTM
comments.body:

comments.author: RJMSTM
comments.body:
Hello @xanthio,

Thank you for your contribution, there will be an **STM32CubeWL3** firmware, and the CMSIS for WL33 will be available within it.
We cannot share a date for the moment. So, stay tuned and thank you once more for your contribution and for your patience. We are looking forward to reading from you again.

With regards,

title: Remove non UTF-8 characters
body:
It is better to not introduce any text which is not UTF-8 encoded.

````
$ grep -axv '.*' Device/ST/STM32WLxx/Include/*
````

See https://github.com/ARMmbed/mbed-os/pull/15137/commits/5e7a7f4b4eb3f84b0286cb94c415fadff3aff627
